When water evaporates, some molecules escape.
Which molecules escape?
A
the molecules at the bottom of the liquid with less energy than others
B
the molecules at the bottom of the liquid with more energy than others
C
the molecules at the surface with less energy than others
D
the molecules at the surface with more energy than others

options.label: A
options.text: the molecules at the bottom of the liquid with less energy than others

options.label: B
options.text: the molecules at the bottom of the liquid with more energy than others

options.label: C
options.text: the molecules at the surface with less energy than others

options.label: D
options.text: the molecules at the surface with more energy than others
